prompt:
Hi, we're VitalCore Wellness and we need urgent help before our Q3 ad campaign goes live in the next 48 hours. Our marketing manager just handed me a raw campaign brief (it's at campaigns/q3_launch/briefs/campaign_brief_raw.json in our workspace) and honestly I'm worried some of the ad copy might get us banned or rejected on Facebook, Google, and TikTok. We've never run paid ads before and our legal team is unavailable this week.

Can you do a full pre-launch compliance review on all the ad copy in that brief and give me a complete, structured report? Save it as compliance_review_report.json. I need to know what's wrong, what needs to be fixed with actual rewritten ad copy I can use instead, and whether we should hold the launch or not. Also flag anything else that looks risky — I think the CEO wanted to target people searching for cancer treatments and I'm not sure if that's okay.
